instruction: Pin Files (Nautilus) and Calculator to the GNOME dock so the favorite-apps list is exactly ['org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop', 'org.gnome.Calculator.desktop'].

evaluator.eval: check_gnome_favorite_apps(get_vm_command_line(env, config={'command': 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps', 'shell': True}), get_rule(env, config={'rules': {'expected': ['org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop', 'org.gnome.Calculator.desktop']}}))
